headline: Herta drives Perez's Cadillac in Brazil FP1 for his last superlicence point
body: Colton Herta takes a sixth Friday practice session of the season after Cadillac found he was one point short of the 40 he needs for an F1 superlicence. Twenty-four laps of Interlagos meets the 100km distance for a point. The team is weighing Bottas for a second year against giving Herta a 2027 debut.
